title: CarlaOcc: An Instance-Centric Panoptic Occupancy Prediction Benchmark for Autonomous Driving
summary: CarlaOcc provides 100K CARLA frames with instance-level panoptic occupancy, voxel resolution up to 0.05 m, exportable actor meshes, and physically consistent mesh voxelization tooling.

mechanisms.name: Instance-centric panoptic occupancy truth
mechanisms.description: Export foreground and background scene meshes and voxelize them into dense, physically consistent semantic and instance occupancy labels instead of inferring truth from rendered pixels alone.
mechanisms.limitations: CarlaOcc targets CARLA UE5 0.10.0 and automotive rigs, while BlindAssist currently uses CARLA 0.9.16. Higher-resolution synthetic truth is not natural-distribution, wearable-sensor, product, user-benefit, or safety evidence.
